title: Regional Key Account Manager (Southern)
description:
**Are you ready to get ahead in your career?**

* We want to empower you to turn your ambitions into achievements.
* We thrive in inclusiveness, diversity and embrace close collaborations for you to create impact for yourself and others.
* Together, we aim to bring the best of technology to help people, businesses and the nation to be ahead in a changing world.
* To realise our vision to become Malaysia’s leading converged solutions company, we are looking for a new talent to innovate and grow with us in a culture that values commitment, performance and possibilities.

**Why does this job exist and why is it critical?**

The Regional Key Account Manager (Southern) is responsible for executing HQ Key Account strategies across partner retail stores within the assigned region. The role serves as the critical link between HQ commercial planning and flawless in store execution, ensuring operational excellence, strong sales performance, and effective partner collaboration across both Modern Trade and Shop in Shop (SIS) partners.

**What you will do:**


1\. Execute Regional Strategies by implementing HQ Key Account strategies across regional partner retail stores to align with business objectives and drive sales performance for prepaid and postpaid products within assigned accounts.


2\. Translate Commercial Plans into clear, actionable in\-store initiatives to ensure consistent execution and enhance customer experience across assigned partner outlets.


3\. Monitor Modern Trade Operations by monitoring merchandising standards, SIM pack stock availability, and competitor activities within assigned partner outlets to ensure optimal brand presence and competitive advantage. Report findings and escalate issues to management.


4\. Support SIS Partner Operations by providing support to SIS Partner crews on Maxis products and systems, assisting with sales enablement and productivity across assigned outlets.


5\. Coach and manage Partner Stakeholder performance by building and maintaining strong relationships with store\-level partner stakeholders to foster effective collaboration and support regional outcomes.


6\. Ensure adherence to processes, standards, and KPIs within assigned accounts, identifying gaps and reporting them to management, and providing performance insights as required.

**Qualifications \& Technical Competencies**


1\. Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field


2\. Minimum 5\+ years in sales management, key account management, or retail operations, preferably in the telecommunications sector

**Skills**

* Strategy Execution (Advanced)
* Retail Operations Management (Experienced)
* Sales Performance Management (Advanced)
* Partner Relationship Management (Advanced)
* Team Leadership (Experienced)
* Data Analysis \& Reporting (Intermediate)
* Merchandising Standards (Experienced)

**What’s next?**

* Once you’ve applied online, our team will carefully review your application. Due to a high volume of applications, we appreciate your patience to allow for a fair and timely review process.
* Should you be shortlisted for the role, we will send you an invitation via email for a digital interview. You can also check on your application status by logging into your candidate account.


Maxis values diverse voices \& people. We hire and reward our employees based on capability \& performance — regardless of ethnicity, gender, age, education, religion, nationality or physical ability.

title: Area Medical Advisor, Specialty, Hepatology
description:
**Job Title \-** Area Medical Advisor, Specialty, Hepatology


**Line Manager Job Title \-** Therapy area Head Medical Affairs, Specialty and General Medicine


**Job Purpose**

* Provide scientific and technical expertise of the highest standards for local medical information, including interactions with Key External Experts (KEEs) and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
* Provide medical and scientific input and information for business strategy for the region.

**Accountability:**

* *primary deliverables of role; its scope; budgetary control (operating/capital), impact on strategy, policy, business or people relationships*
* Develop and sustain credible networking with appropriate Health Care Practitioners (HCPs)
* Plan, facilitate and conduct CMEs, symposia, trainings, workshops, scientific meetings, speaker tours, and other product specific campaigns and deliver scientific presentations with consistent messages for key products at these meetings, as required.
* Support and deliver scientific presentations with consistent “on label” messages at medical education meetings.
* Understand principles of and support Scientific Engagement (SE) activities as per Medical Plans.
* Have clarity in understanding on Scientific Engagements and Promotional Code.
* Become an expert in Hepatology where GSK have brands and support associated activities related to those brands.
* Be updated on scientific knowledge on Hepatology; GSK molecules and its PI to ensure its ‘On Label’ communications on various platforms.
* Support in feasibility assessment of potential research sites, develop concept notes, proposals, budgets, data collection and monitoring tools for field studies.
* Provide medical inputs into development and execution of brand strategy.
* Pharmacovigilance: Support Named Safety contact in strengthening of Hepatology Pharmacovigilance; ensure self\-learning.
* Knowledge/ Education / Previous Experience Required

**Educational Background**

* Minimum Level of Education \- MBBS with post graduate qualification
* Preferred Level of Education \- Post graduate qualification in Pharmacology / Public Health

**Job\-Related Experience**

**Minimum Level of Job\-Related Experience required**

* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, local language
* Experience of presenting scientific topics at different settings
* A sound understanding of the principles and practice of ICH\-GCP and internal SOPs.
* Well\-demonstrated ability to understand scientific methods and experimental design.
* 1\-2 years in the pharmaceutical industry preferably in the Gastroenterology / Hepatology therapy area.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* MBBS or MD (Postgraduate)
* Strong understanding of disease management and ability to engage in scientific discussions with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs)
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills
* Understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulations and promotional compliance

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* MD in Pharmacology, Paediatrics, General Medicine, Community Medicine, or related specialty
* 1\-2 years of experience in a Medical Affairs/Medical Advisor role within the pharmaceutical industry
* Experience in Hepatology or relevant therapy area preferred

### **Key Skills \& Experience**

* Scientific engagement and medical communication with HCPs
* Cross\-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Medical teams
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations and compliance standards
* Ability to interpret and communicate clinical data effectively
Certifications or experience in digital scientific engagement/content delivery are an added advantage  
* 

  

**Skills**

Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, External Stakeholder Management, High Impact Communication, Patient Impact  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.


**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.


Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.


**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.


It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.


**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager with strong hands\-on expertise in planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant performance marketing platforms. The candidate should be analytical, ROI\-focused, and capable of driving quality leads, conversions, and measurable business growth.

The candidate must also have practical knowledge of implementing AI tools in day\-to\-day performance marketing work. This includes using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI powered platforms for campaign research, ad copy ideation, audience analysis, reporting automation, competitor research, workflow improvement, and productivity enhancement.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Campaign Strategy \& Planning \- Plan and execute paid media strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other platforms. Build full\-funnel PPC campaigns for awareness, lead generation, remarketing, and conversions. Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, keyword research, and campaign forecasting. Define campaign objectives, budgets, KPIs, expected outcomes, and optimization roadmaps.  
2\. Google Ads Management Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Remarketing campaigns. Conduct keyword research, negative keyword management, ad copy testing, and bid optimization. Optimize campaigns for CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and budget efficiency. Monitor Quality Score, impression share, search terms, auction insights, and conversion performance.  
3\. Meta, LinkedIn \& Paid Social Campaigns Plan and manage campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other paid social platforms. Create audience segmentation, retargeting funnels, lookalike audiences, and creative testing plans. Coordinate with design and content teams to improve ad creatives, messaging, landing pages, and CTAs. Analyze campaign performance by audience, creative, placement, device, geography, and funnel stage.  
4\. AI Implementation in Day\-to\-Day PPC Work \- Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other relevant AI platforms to improve campaign planning, research, content ideation, and execution speed. Apply AI for keyword expansion, competitor research, landing page analysis, ad copy variations, headline testing, and campaign hypothesis creation.

Use AI\-assisted workflows for reporting summaries, performance insights, dashboard interpretation, and weekly optimization recommendations.   Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PPC tasks such as reporting, data interpretation, creative brief generation, lead quality analysis, and internal campaign documentation. Collaborate with marketing, content, design, and automation teams to integrate AI into campaign workflows without compromising quality, accuracy, or brand standards.

5\. Tracking, Analytics \& Reporting \- Set up and monitor conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Conversion APIs, and relevant CRM integrations. Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and next\-step recommendations. Track CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, impression share, and budget utilization. Identify campaign gaps, wasted spend, tracking issues, and opportunities for scale.

6\. Optimization \& Growth \- Continuously test ad copies, landing pages, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and campaign structures. Improve campaign performance through A/B testing, funnel analysis, data\-led optimization, and AI supported insights. Work with landing page, SEO, content, and sales teams to improve conversion quality and sales outcomes. Manage budgets efficiently and scale high\-performing campaigns.

7\. Team \& Stakeholder Coordination \- Coordinate with internal teams, designers, developers, content writers, sales teams, and automation teams. Present campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to management, clients, or stakeholders. Mentor junior PPC executives and guide them on campaign execution, reporting, optimization, and responsible use of AI tools. Maintain clear communication around campaign priorities, deadlines, blockers, and outcomes.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a results\-driven and creative **Digital Marketing Executive** with **2\-4 years of experience** to join our growing IT firm. The ideal candidate will be well\-versed in the latest digital marketing strategies and tools, particularly in the IT sector. As part of our team, you will be responsible for planning, implementing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness, lead generation, and overall business growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies to support business goals, enhance brand awareness and drive lead generation across various digital platforms.
* Oversee the management and optimization of on\-page and off\-page SEO, manage Google Ads campaigns, social media ads and perform keyword research to drive organic and paid traffic.
* Create, curate, and manage content across various platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) to increase brand visibility and engagement.
* Work closely with the content writer and graphics designer to ensure compelling marketing materials.
* Design and execute email marketing campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize to increase open rates and conversions.
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as website traffic, conversion rates, social media engagement, and ROI. Provide monthly reports and actionable insights to improve campaigns.
* Create and implement strategies to attract high\-quality leads, leveraging inbound marketing, paid campaigns, and email outreach.
* Work with the sales and product teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business objectives.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (Must).
* The ideal candidate should be well\-versed in the latest digital marketing strategies and tools such as OMIT, particularly in the IT sector
* Minimum 1\-2 years of experience in digital marketing, with a proven track record of success in the IT industry or a similar technical field.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Ads, SEO tools (Moz, SEMrush, Ahrefs), social media management platforms (Hootsuite, Buffer), and email marketing tools (Mailchimp, HubSpot).
* Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, PPC, social media advertising, and content marketing strategies.
* Strong analytical skills to evaluate campaign performance and implement data\-driven decisions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to create clear, concise, and persuasive marketing copy.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

**Desired Attributes:**

* Creative thinker with a passion for digital marketing and technology.
* Detail\-oriented with an eye for accuracy and quality.
* Adaptable to changing trends in digital marketing and technology.
* Team player who can collaborate effectively across departments.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Digital marketing: 3 years (Required)
* SEO: 3 years (Required)
* Google Ads: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

title: SEO Manager
description:

* Plan and implement **on\-page, off\-page, technical, local, and international SEO** strategies.
* Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, SEO audits, and website performance checks.
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, leads, conversions, and overall SEO performance.
* Plan and manage content marketing, link building, and other SEO activities.
* Find new SEO opportunities to improve website rankings, traffic, and leads.
* Work with content writers, developers, designers, and other digital marketing teams to complete SEO tasks.
* Train, guide, and monitor SEO team members to improve their skills and performance.
* Manage multiple client projects and make sure SEO plans support their business goals.
* Prepare SEO reports and explain performance, results, and next steps to clients and management.

* **10\+ years of experience in SEO and digital marketing.**
* Experience managing and leading an SEO team.
* Strong knowledge of **technical, on\-page, off\-page, local, and content SEO**.
* Experience with **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Semrush**, and other SEO tools.
* Good knowledge of **WordPress, website structure, schema markup, internal linking, indexing, crawling, and website optimization**.
* Good leadership, communication, client\-handling, and project management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to create and manage SEO strategies for different clients and industries.

* Ability to manage deadlines, prioritize work, and maintain good quality.
